why: Reduce measured cold editor loading without skipping source bounds checks or changing rendered resident artwork.
change: Cache ImageData dimensions outside the pixel loop; make discarded hair and garment audit-only probes CPU-backed. Final composition canvases unchanged.
correctness: 1804 differential region-audit cases pass against the shipped reference, including alpha thresholds, fractional regions, offset arrays and unchanged inputs.
Fixed 98 percent coverage and invalid/sparse input checks pass.
200 before/after Metal resident frame RGBA hashes and contact/shadow metadata match exactly for four v5/v6 looks, including all poses and two feeding-return variants.
All three maximum-fixture trusted brush/group-move exact saved undo/redo checks pass; no page errors.
visualReview: All three final desktop captures individually inspected; no missing/corrupt map, cast or editor panels in these samples.
limits: One before/after cold run per biome, not repeated distributions or controlled physical-display measurements.
Cold times vary and remain long. Native compile/refresh commit latency is not fixed by this change.
Four complete resident looks are not every supported material combination, backend or full art acceptance.
Broader original release requirements remain open.
